```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<robot name="cabinet_with_one_hinged_door">

  <!-- ==================== -->
  <!-- Main cabinet body   -->
  <!-- ==================== -->
  <link name="cabinet_body">
    <!-- Visual -->
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.51" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.75 0.41 1.02"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="light_wood">
        <color rgba="0.8 0.7 0.5 1.0"/>
      </material>
    </visual>

    <!-- Collision -->
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.51" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.75 0.41 1.02"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>

    <!-- Inertial (approximate) -->
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.51" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="30.0"/>
      <!-- Box inertia: Ixx = (1/12) m (h^2 + d^2) etc. -->
      <inertia ixx="13.5" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="13.5" iyz="0.0"
               izz="5.0"/>
    </inertial>
  </link>

  <!-- ==================== -->
  <!-- Door                -->
  <!-- ==================== -->
  <link name="door">
    <!-- Visual -->
    <visual>
      <!-- Door thickness 2 cm -->
      <origin xyz="0.375 0 0.51" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.75 0.02 1.02"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="dark_wood">
        <color rgba="0.4 0.2 0.1 1.0"/>
      </material>
    </visual>

    <!-- Collision -->
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0.375 0 0.51" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.75 0.02 1.02"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>

    <!-- Inertial (approximate) -->
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0.375 0 0.51" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="8.0"/>
      <!-- Treat as thin plate -->
      <inertia ixx="0.12" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="4.5" iyz="0.0"
               izz="4.5"/>
    </inertial>
  </link>

  <!-- ==================== -->
  <!-- Hinge joint         -->
  <!-- ==================== -->
  <joint name="door_hinge" type="revolute">
    <!-- Hinge on the left vertical edge of the cabinet (X = -0.375) -->
    <parent link="cabinet_body"/>
    <child  link="door"/>
    <origin xyz="-0.375 0 0.51" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="0 0 1"/>
    <limit effort="100.0" velocity="1.0" lower="0.0" upper="1.5708"/>
    <dynamics damping="0.1" friction="0.2"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- ==================== -->
  <!-- Fixed base joint (optional) -->
  <!-- ==================== -->
  <joint name="world_to_cabinet" type="fixed">
    <parent link="world"/>
    <child  link="cabinet_body"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

</robot>
```
